title: The right-localized pullback of a fibred category is fibred

standard_prerequisites.name: Right localization of categories
standard_prerequisites.use: Describe u_pS as the localization of u_{pp}S at R and give the canonical functor p_p extending p_{pp}.

standard_prerequisites.name: Morphisms and equality in the localization
standard_prerequisites.use: Represent morphisms of u_pS as fractions and decide equality after further localization; used in the uniqueness part.

standard_prerequisites.name: Composition of strongly cartesian morphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces strong cartesianness of a fraction to that of its numerator.

core_obligations: Characterize strongly cartesian morphisms of u_pS: a fraction is strongly cartesian iff its numerator (a, b, alpha) has alpha strongly cartesian in S.

Existence: for a target arrow b o b_1, build the fibre product U' = U x_{U_2} U_1, lift its projection by a strongly cartesian gamma, solve for alpha_1 through strong cartesianness of alpha, and exhibit the resulting fraction pair as the required lift.

Uniqueness: represent two candidate solutions as fractions with common denominator, precompose by the equalizer subobject to force equality of base components, and use strong cartesianness of alpha for the fibre components.
Conclude u_pS is fibred by producing the required strongly cartesian morphisms over arbitrary base arrows.
proof_roadmap: Characterize the strongly cartesian fractions, then prove existence by an explicit fibred base change and uniqueness by equalizer reduction, and conclude fibredness.
difficulty_reason: Longest proof in the batch: a characterization claim, an explicit multi-object existence construction with commutative diagrams, and a delicate uniqueness argument requiring an additional equalizer precomposition.
